desc: 蓝灰雾调单色版面拆解一体式圆筒机型的九屏卖点节奏
leaf: 一体式触控圆筒加湿器
name: 银白圆筒一体式触控加湿器款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼拿下点击，用纯净雾白底交代一体式圆筒外观与无屏显机身
一秒给出核心主张并用六枚细线图标位收拢全套卖点
shots.textZone: upper-left headline band plus one short label under each of the six icon rings

shots.intent: 放大久用后矿物残留与频繁换水的日常摩擦，逼出换新动机
shots.textZone: one short label under each panel, bottom band kept clear

shots.intent: 把机器放进寒冷季节的居家角落，让买家自我代入使用位置
用侧面微距证明机身一体式结构与进风格栅做工
shots.textZone: one short label on the blank plaque only

shots.intent: 把看不见的出雾量转成可见的雾柱机制解释屏
shots.textZone: one short label near the lower left, upper half kept clear

shots.intent: 回答容量与续航类疑问但只给空白数字位，由下游按实参填
shots.textZone: top-left headline plus one label under each blank numeral well

shots.intent: 让买家在同一光位下比较配置版本，收掉选择焦虑
shots.textZone: one short label under each unit plus a headline row along the top

shots.intent: 用空白证章位与机身细节降低风险感，替掉不可核实的资质宣称
shots.textZone: two short labels beneath the empty seal outline

shots.intent: 以夜间氛围收束全套并留一个干净的行动位替代促销贴片
shots.textZone: upper closing line plus one empty button plaque beneath it

style.backgroundSystem: single flat steel-blue field #7A98BF and pale mist field #F2F5F8 with a soft vertical falloff, alternating with charcoal #23252A and deep ink-navy #161D2E horizontal bands; one frosted translucent plate #DCE4EE is the only overlay surface, no photographic set backdrops
style.iconSystem: thin-line circular icons at 1.5px stroke in #5FB3BE on a two-by-three ring grid, plus blank seal outlines and empty rounded plaques, no filled, 3D or skeuomorphic icons
style.lightingSystem: cool 6500K soft wraparound key from the upper left with a gentle bounce fill, one cropped leaf shadow on wide fields, tight grounded contact shadow, no hard speculars and no warm lamp cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool mist-blue environmental-appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pale mist field #F2F5F8, steel-blue field #7A98BF, deep ink-navy band #161D2E and aqua accent #5FB3BE with charcoal text #2E3948; cool 6500K soft wraparound key from the upper left with a gentle bounce fill, one cropped leaf shadow and a tight grounded contact shadow; single flat material fields with a soft vertical falloff and one frosted translucent plate #DCE4EE as the only overlay, charcoal #23252A and ink-navy horizontal bands for the mechanism screens; modern geometric sans-serif with an uppercase eyebrow pair at the top-left, a micro-label at the top-right, a three-tick chapter marker and left-right alternating headline blocks; thin-line circular icons at 1.5px stroke in #5FB3BE; stable upright frontal product angle and scale, control wells and level indicators always blank with no digits or graduations; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered readouts, no promotional corner badges.
noDrift: no colour palette changes and no warm orange, gold or amber accent replacing the aqua #5FB3BE
no mixed fonts, no serif, no handwritten or cartoon lettering
no random photographic backgrounds and no marble, stone or wood-grain studio sweeps
no inconsistent lighting and no warm bedside lamp cast on the night band
no rendered digits, units, readouts, scale graduations or user-interface screens
no membership corner badges, QR blocks, price tags or promotional stickers
style.presentationRules: product kept upright, centred and at stable scale on a frontal eye-level axis; control wells, any screen area and the water-level strip always read blank with no glyph, digit or graduation; mist rendered as a fine translucent plume, never as a solid shape
style.surfaceSystem: matte porcelain-stock plinth #E6EBF1 with a bare ash-wood edge #D2BFA6 for scenes, frosted translucent plate #DCE4EE for graphic screens, never marble or wood-grain studio sweeps
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only: uppercase eyebrow pair at the top-left with a micro-label at the top-right, a three-tick chapter marker, left-right alternating headline blocks, headline 36-44pt, sub-line 18-22pt, label 12-14pt, all copy supplied as placeholders
